profile.what: One of the world's largest automotive component groups: wiring harnesses, bumpers and interior/exterior polymer modules, rear-view mirrors and camera systems, cockpit/front-end module assembly, lighting, elastomers, precision metals, plus non-auto businesses (consumer-electronics glass, aerospace, logistics, health & medical, IT). 425+ facilities in 47 countries (Q4FY26 PPT). Gross revenue FY26 Rs1,94,010 cr (USD 22.9 bn at constant currency); economic revenue incl. 100% of JVs Rs1,43,288 cr; reported revenue Rs1,26,104 cr.

divisionsFY26: PV and CV harnesses: India (incl. JVs: MSWIL 33.43%, Kyungshin 50%), PKC (CV harnesses, North America and Europe; acquired 2017), from Jul-2026 Nexans Autoelectric
Bumpers, door panels, instrument panels, sunroofs and fuel tanks: SMP (ex-Peguform), SMRC (ex-Reydel), Yachiyo; 57% of revenue made in Europe
SMR rear-view mirrors and camera-monitoring systems; JV Ningbo SMR Huaxiang in China
SAS: cockpit and front-end module assembly for European OEMs; revenue net of customer-nominated parts (Ind AS 115 agent)

Lighting & electronics, precision metals & modules (incl. consumer-electronics glass), elastomers, technology & industrial solutions, aerospace, logistics, health & medical; from Q2FY27 Vehicle Systems (Yutaka Giken)

q1fy27.industry: Global light-vehicle production -1.8% YoY (China -3.1%); global CV production estimated +5.4% on the North American recovery; India LV +12.8%, India CV +16.2% (PPT slide 7, call)
callPoints: Highest-ever quarterly revenue (Rs35,244 cr, +17% YoY, +3% QoQ): Q1 usually falls from Q4. Wiring harness +31% (India, North American Class-8 truck recovery); MPP, Vision and Integrated Assemblies grew 'in line with the industry'; Emerging +30% (consumer electronics, aerospace +20%).

EBITDA +26% to Rs3,104 cr (8.8%, +60bp YoY, but -230bp QoQ from the Q4 settlement quarter). MPP margin +50bp YoY to 6.9% thanks to European restructuring 'to breathe with the market' (headcount and plant consolidation).

Copper +40% YoY and +4% QoQ (after +13% and +16% in the two previous quarters); polymer prices in Germany +55% YoY and +66% QoQ after the Middle East conflict; container freight +40% YoY. Pass-through comes with a 1-2 quarter lag for copper (3-6 months, per Pankaj Mital) and mostly at year-end (Q4) for polymers.
No one-offs in Q1FY27; normalised PAT +55% (reported +102%).
Capex Rs1,614 cr (52% of EBITDA); FY27 guidance Rs6,000 cr +/-10%; 3 plants opened in Q1, 13 under construction, 10 to open in FY27, all in emerging markets.
Leverage 0.8x net debt (incl. leases, excl. CCDs) / EBITDA, the lowest ever; policy ceiling 2.5x, internal aspiration below 1.5x.

Nexans Autoelectric (closed 3-Jul-2026) and Yutaka Giken (closed 21-Jul-2026) together add 'close to USD 2 bn' of annual revenue; their margins start below the group and are to be raised toward 'comparable industry' levels.

Consumer electronics: third plant ('the largest facility in Motherson', 40 mn units a year at full scale) to be commissioned in Q3FY27; total programme ~Rs7,500 cr, one third spent; the JV partner holds 10% (option to 49%). FY26 consumer-electronics revenue ~Rs1,300 cr at ~8% EBITDA (analyst, not contested).
Some incubated businesses may be listed separately within the five-year plan ('the faster, the better').

guidance.said: USD 108 bn gross revenue by FY2030 (from USD 22.9 bn in FY26), 40% ROCE, no country/customer/component above 10% (3CX10), payout up to 40% of consolidated profit; incubated businesses to be listed separately.
guidance.outcome: FY26 gross revenue USD 22.9 bn (constant currency); company ROCE 16.1%; payout 16.4%. The Vision 2025 targets (USD 36 bn revenue, 40% ROCE) were missed (MOSL).

guidance.said: ~Rs6,000 cr +/-10%, half growth (60% of that non-auto), half maintenance.
Long-term pass-through arrangements; one to two quarters' lag before settlements.
guidance.outcome: Q1FY27 margin up 60bp YoY despite copper +40%.

guidance.said: 'A big chunk of it is done'; more resizing possible as acquisitions come in.
guidance.outcome: FY26 exceptional costs Rs379 cr pre-tax; none in Q1FY27.

guidance.said: Nexans + Yutaka ~USD 2 bn annual revenue; margins to move toward industry levels over time; 40% ROCE aspiration applies to acquired units.
Third plant in Q3FY27; 'please be patient for another couple of quarters' for revenue run-rates.
